metadata.question: Between June 15-21, 2017, did temperatures in Las Vegas, Nevada exceed 130 degrees fahrenheit?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy - Collection: NASA/GLDAS-V20/NOAH/G025/T3H (3-hourly, skin surface temperature in Kelvin) - Date: 2017-06-15 to 2017-06-21 (inclusive) - Location: Las Vegas, NV – point geometry at [-115.14, 36.17] 2. Masking strategy - Not needed; this product is modelled re-analysis, no clouds. 3. Logic - Convert Kelvin → °C → °F. - Get the max T_skin value over the 7-day window. - If the collection size is 0 → C1. - If max is None / NaN or outside physical range (<–100 °C or >100 °C) → C3. - If max Fahrenheit > 130 → A, else B. - Always report: image count, max °F, pixel count for validation. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-115.14, 36.17]) start, end = '2017-06-15', '2017-06-21' # 2. Acquire data col = (ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GLDAS-V20/NOAH/G025/T3H') .filterDate(start, end) .select('Tair_f_inst')) # 3-hourly air temperature [K] n = col.size().getInfo() if n == 0: print("No images found.") print("C1") exit() # 3. Processing maxK = col.max() # per-pixel max in Kelvin count = maxK.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=pt, scale=25000, maxPixels=1e9).get('Tair_f_inst').getInfo() if count == 0: print("No valid pixels.") print("C2") exit() # 4. Calculation maxKval = maxK.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.first(), geometry=pt, scale=25000, maxPixels=1e9).get('Tair_f_inst').getInfo() if maxKval is None or maxKval != maxKval: # NaN check print("Calculation failed.") print("C3") exit() maxF = (maxKval - 273.15) * 9/5 + 32 # K → °F # 5. Result print(f"Images: {n}, Max F: {maxF:.1f}, Pixels: {int(count)}") print("A" if maxF > 130 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-115.14, 36.17])
start, end = '2017-06-15', '2017-06-21'

# 2. Acquire data
col = (ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GLDAS-V20/NOAH/G025/T3H')
       .filterDate(start, end)
       .select('Tair_f_inst'))          # 3-hourly air temperature [K]

n = col.size().getInfo()
if n == 0:
    print("No images found.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Processing
maxK = col.max()                        # per-pixel max in Kelvin
count = maxK.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=pt, scale=25000, maxPixels=1e9).get('Tair_f_inst').getInfo()
if count == 0:
    print("No valid pixels.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()

# 4. Calculation
maxKval = maxK.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.first(),
    geometry=pt, scale=25000, maxPixels=1e9).get('Tair_f_inst').getInfo()
if maxKval is None or maxKval != maxKval:   # NaN check
    print("Calculation failed.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    exit()

maxF = (maxKval - 273.15) * 9/5 + 32        # K → °F

# 5. Result
print(f"Images: {n}, Max F: {maxF:.1f}, Pixels: {int(count)}")
print("<answer>A</answer>" if maxF > 130 else "<answer>B</answer>")
